formulations.name: Brahma Rasayana (First)
formulations.preparation_method: Five root pentads boiled in ten times water, reduced to one-tenth, filtered. Haritaki and amalaki fruits seeded and pounded, mixed into decoction with herb powders and sugarcandy. Tila oil and ghee cooked in copper utensil on mild fire until linctus consistency. Honey added after cooling. Kept in ghee-uncted vessel.
formulations.dosage: Dose that does not disturb digestion of food
formulations.anupana: Sastika rice with milk after drug is digested

formulations.name: Brahma Rasayana (Second / Amalaka Brahma Rasayana)

ingredients.quantity: 1000 fruits steamed + juice of 1000 fresh fruits for impregnation

formulations.preparation_method: Amalaki fruits steamed on milk vapour, dried in shade, seeds removed and powdered. Powder impregnated 21 times with juice of 1000 fresh amalaki fruits. Herb powders added in 1/8 quantity. Impregnated with nagabala juice 40 kg and dried in shade. Ghee or ghee-honey added and shaped into boluses. Stored underground in ashes for fortnight after protective rites. After fortnight, metal bhasmas added in 1/8 quantity.
formulations.dosage: 5 gm gradually increasing daily in every morning according to power of digestion
formulations.anupana: Sastika rice with milk added with ghee after drug is digested

formulations.name: Cyavanaprasa

ingredients.form: seeded, fried in tila oil and ghee

formulations.preparation_method: All herbs boiled in 100 litres 240 ml water till fully extracted. Decoction brought down. Amalaki fruits taken out, seeded, fried in tila oil and ghee 480 gm, cooked in above decoction with sugarcandy as linctus. After self-cooling, honey 240 gm added. Finally twak, ela, patra and nagakesara 160 gm added.
formulations.dosage: Dose which does not interfere with food intake and digestion

formulations.name: Amalaka Rasayana (Fourth - Triphala Baked)
formulations.preparation_method: Fruits wrapped in palasa bark, pasted with mud, cooked on charcoal. Seeds removed. Pounded in mortar with curd, ghee, honey, sesamum paste, tila oil and sugar. Taken on empty stomach. After course, patient normalised with gruel, massaged with ghee and barley powder.
formulations.anupana: Sastika rice with ghee along with soup or milk for double the treatment period

formulations.name: Haritaki Ghrita (Fifth Formulation of Haritaki)

ingredients.herb_name: Amalaka powder (impregnated 100 times with amalaka juice)

formulations.preparation_method: Ghee extracted from milk cooked with paste of listed herbs. Mixed with honey, sugar and amalaka powder (impregnated 100 times with amalaka juice) and iron bhasma in 1/4 quantity. Taken 10 gm every morning.
indications: life-span of hundred years free from old age
formulations.anupana: Evening diet of sali and sastika rice with ghee along with soup of green gram or milk

formulations.name: Amalakaghrta

ingredients.herb_name: Amalaka juice (from good soil, mature fruits)

formulations.preparation_method: Ghee cooked with amalaka juice and punarnava paste. Process repeated with vidari juice and jivanti paste. Then with four times milk and decoction of bala and atibala with shatavari paste. Process repeated hundred or thousand times. Sugar and honey added in 1/4 quantity. Kept in golden, silver or earthen pitcher uncted with ghee.
formulations.dosage: According to power of digestion every morning
formulations.anupana: Sali or sastika rice with milk and ghee after drug digested

formulations.name: Amalakavaleha (First)

ingredients.form: dipped in alkaline water from palasa tree, dried, seeded, powdered
dipped in alkaline water, dried, seeded, powdered

formulations.preparation_method: Fruits dipped in alkaline water from palasa tree. Dried in shade, seeds removed and powdered. Powder mixed with four times honey, ghee and quarter sugar. Kept in ghee-uncted vessel stored underground for six months.
indications: stable lifespan of hundred years without old age
formulations.dosage: According to power of digestion only in forenoon, not in afternoon

formulations.name: Amalaka-churna

ingredients.herb_name: Amalaki fruit powder (impregnated 21 days with amalaki juice)

formulations.preparation_method: Amalaki powder impregnated with amalaki juice for 21 days and nights. Mixed with honey, ghee, pippali and sugar. Kept in ghee-uncted vessel stored in early rains under heap of ashes. Used after rainy season is over.
indications: stable lifespan of one hundred years devoid of old age
formulations.dosage: According to suitable and wholesome diet

formulations.name: Vidangavaleha
formulations.preparation_method: All mixed together and kept in ghee-uncted vessel stored in early rains under heap of ashes.

formulations.name: Amalakavaleha (Second)

ingredients.form: heated in covered tub with cowdung fire, seeded, crushed

formulations.preparation_method: Amalaka fruits heated in covered tub of fresh palasa wood with cowdung fire. Cooled, seeds removed, crushed. Mixed with pippali powder, vidanga powder, sugar, oil, honey and ghee. Kept in clean strong vessel uncted with ghee for 21 days.
indications: life-span of hundred years devoid of old age

formulations.name: Nagabala Rasayana
formulations.preparation_method: Roots collected in cala muhurta in month of Magha or Phalguna from forest with specific soil conditions. Roots washed, bark taken 40 gm finely pounded. Used with milk every morning or as powder with milk or with honey and ghee.
indications: stable lifespan of hundred years without senility
formulations.anupana: Milk; or honey and ghee. After digestion: sali or sastika rice with milk and ghee.

formulations.name: Bala-Chandanadi Rasayana
formulations.preparation_method: Juice of listed drugs used by method as in nagabala. If fresh juice not available: drug dipped in equal water for 24 hours, pressed and filtered as svarasa.

formulations.name: Bhallataka-Ksira (Bhallataka with milk)

ingredients.quantity: 10 fruits increasing by 1 daily to 30, total 1000
ingredients.form: crushed, boiled in 10 times water to 1/8th extract

formulations.preparation_method: Bhallataka fruits collected in month of Jyestha or Asadha, stored in barley/black gram granary for 4 months. After 4 months taken out. Starting with 10 fruits, crushed and boiled in 10 times water to 1/8th. Filtered, taken with milk. Mouth smeared with ghee before taking. Dose increased by 1 fruit per day to maximum 30. Total 1000 fruits. After treatment, milk diet for double the treatment period.
indications: stable lifespan of hundred years without senility
formulations.dosage: 10 fruits increasing by 1 daily up to 30, then decreasing
formulations.anupana: Sali or sastika rice with milk added with ghee. Milk diet after treatment for double period.
contraindications: must prepare body first with cold, unctuous and sweet substances

formulations.name: Bhallatakaksaudra (Bhallataka with honey)

ingredients.form: crushed, heated in vessel, extract collected

formulations.preparation_method: Bhallataka fruits crushed, filled in heating vessel placed on firm uncted pitcher dug underground upto neck. Covered with lid, pasted with black earth, heated with cowdung fire. Extract collected in lower pitcher. Taken mixed with 1/8 honey and double ghee.
indications: stable lifespan of hundred years without old age

formulations.name: Bhallataka Taila (Bhallataka oil cooked with madhuka)
formulations.preparation_method: Bhallataka taila cooked with milk and paste of madhuka in 1/8 quantity. Process repeated hundred times.

formulations.name: Aindra Rasayana
formulations.preparation_method: All mixed together and used. After food is digested, diet with honey and plenty of ghee given.
formulations.anupana: Honey and plenty of ghee after food is digested

formulations.name: Intellect-Promoting Rasayana Drugs (Medhya Rasayana)
formulations.preparation_method: Each used separately: juice of mandukaparni; powder of yastimadhu with milk; juice of guduchi stem along with root and flowers; paste of shankhapushpi.

formulations.name: Pippali Rasayana (Simple)

ingredients.quantity: 5, 7, 8 or 10 fruits for one year; or 3 fruits thrice daily
ingredients.form: impregnated with palasa alkali, fried in ghee

formulations.preparation_method: Pippali fruits impregnated with alkali of palasa then fried in ghee. Taken with honey. Used for one year.
formulations.dosage: 5, 7, 8 or 10 fruits with honey and ghee; or 3 fruits thrice daily for one year

formulations.name: Pippali Vardhamana Rasayana (Graduated Pippali)

ingredients.form: paste / decoction / powder as per strength

formulations.preparation_method: Day 1: 10 pippali. Each day add 10 more until day 10 (100 total). From day 11, decrease by 10 daily back to 10 on day 19. High strength: paste; medium strength: decoction; low strength: powder.
formulations.dosage: 10 increasing to 100 over 10 days, then decreasing back to 10 over next 9 days
formulations.anupana: Sastika rice with ghee extracted from milk after drug digested

formulations.name: Triphala Rasayana (First)
formulations.preparation_method: Taken with honey and ghee for one year in specified timing and quantities.
indications: hundred years free from old age and diseases
formulations.dosage: Haritaki 1 after digestion; Bibhitaka 2 after meals; Amalaki 4 after meals

formulations.name: Triphala Rasayana (Iron Plate Method)
formulations.preparation_method: New iron plate plastered with triphala paste. After 24 hours paste collected and taken dissolved in honey water. Meals taken with plenty of fat. Observed for one year.
indications: hundred years devoid of senility and diseases
formulations.anupana: Meals with plenty of fat after drug digested

formulations.name: Triphala Rasayana with Madhuka
formulations.preparation_method: Triphala mixed with madhuka, tugaksiri and pippali with honey and ghee.

formulations.name: Triphala Rasayana with Metals

ingredients.herb_name: All six metals including gold (Suvarna, Rajata, Tamra, Loha, etc.)

formulations.preparation_method: Triphala with metals, vaca, vidanga and pippali or with lavana taken with honey and ghee for one year.

formulations.name: Silajatu Rasayana
formulations.preparation_method: Silajatu impregnated in lukewarm decoction of vata/pitta/kapha alleviating drugs by dipping and removing at end of day. Repeated for a week. Mixed with powdered metals and taken with milk.
formulations.dosage: 40 gm (superior), 20 gm (medium), 10 gm (inferior). Duration: 7 weeks (superior), 3 weeks (medium), 1 week (inferior)

formulations.name: Lauhadi Rasayana (Iron Rasayana)

ingredients.form: heated red-hot, dipped in decoction, powdered like collyrium

ingredients.herb_name: Alkali from lavana, ingudi and palasa

formulations.preparation_method: Iron pieces 4 fingers long heated red hot, dipped in decoction of triphala, cow urine and alkali till transformed like collyrium. Powdered finely. Mixed with honey and amalaka juice as linctus. Kept in ghee-uncted pitcher in barley granary for one year, stirred monthly. After one year, taken with honey and ghee every morning per strength with suitable diet.
indications: invincibility against injury, diseases, senility and death

formulations.name: Amalakayasa Brahma Rasayana

ingredients.herb_name: Amalaki (hand-plucked fruits, dried, powdered, impregnated 21 times with amalaka juice)

formulations.preparation_method: All drugs boiled in ten times water to one-tenth decoction. Filtered and amalaka powder added. Heated on cowdung fire till liquid evaporated. Collected, dried on iron plates, powdered finely on deer-hide with stone slabs. Stored in iron vessel. Iron bhasma added in 1/4 quantity. Mixed with honey and ghee for use.
indications: strength of intellect and sense organs

formulations.name: Broad-Spectrum Rasayana (Indra's Second Rasayana)
formulations.preparation_method: All juices cooked with cow-milk, tila oil and cow-ghee till fatty preparation. Brought down. Amalaka powder, honey, sugar, vamsalocana and pippali mixed in. Kept in earthen jar smeared with ghee for fortnight. Metal bhasmas in 1/16 quantity mixed before use.
indications: strength to psyche / memory / physique / agni / intellect / senses
formulations.dosage: According to digestion. Avoid exertion and sexual intercourse during medication.
formulations.anupana: Sastika rice with ghee extracted from milk

formulations.name: Sara-adi Bulk-Promoting Bolus (Vajikarana)
formulations.preparation_method: Drugs 120 gm each with black gram 2.56 kg cooked in 10.24 litres water to 1/4. Pastes of madhuka, draksa, phalgu, pippali, kapikacchi, madhika and shatavari added with juices and ghee 2.56 kg and milk 10.24 litres. Cooked till ghee remains. Filtered, sugar, vamsalocana, pippali, marica, twak, ela, nagakesara powders added. Honey 320 gm mixed in. Solid boluses of 40 gm prepared and fried in ghee.
formulations.dosage: 40 gm bolus according to digestive power

formulations.name: Aphrodisiac Ghee (Kapikacchi-Ashwagandha)
formulations.preparation_method: Black gram and kapikacchi boiled together to decoction with listed herbs. Ghee, cow-milk and juices added and cooked on mild fire until ghee remains. Sugar, vamsalocana, honey, pippali added to prepared ghee.

formulations.name: Satavari Ghrita (Aphrodisiac)
formulations.preparation_method: Ghee prepared with shatavari in ten times milk. Added with sugar, pippali and honey.

formulations.name: Madhuka Aphrodisiac Formulation
formulations.preparation_method: 10 gm madhuka powder mixed with ghee and honey, taken with milk.

formulations.name: Pippali Aphrodisiac (Thirty Pippali with milk)

ingredients.form: well-pounded, fried in tila oil and ghee

formulations.preparation_method: 30 pippali fried in tila oil and ghee 40 gm each, added with sugar and honey. Processed with milk stream according to strength. Taken with sastika rice diet and ghee extracted from milk.
indications: no diminution in stiffness of organs
formulations.anupana: Sastika rice with ghee extracted from milk

formulations.name: Kapikacchi-Shatavari Fertility Juice
formulations.preparation_method: Ingredients boiled in milk and water each 640 ml till 640 ml remains. Filtered with clean cloth. Sugar, vamsalocana and fresh ghee added. Mixed with honey before taking. Taken with boiled sastika rice.
indications: large progeny for even old and weak

formulations.name: Shatavari-Vidari Ghrita (Virility Ghee)
formulations.preparation_method: Decoctions prepared separately for each herb. Ghee cooked with eight times milk using these decoctions. Sugar and honey added.

formulations.name: Vidari Ghrita (Hundred Times Processed)
formulations.preparation_method: Ghee 2.56 kg cooked with vidari juice hundred times quantity. Then cooked again with hundred times cow-ghee. Final preparations of sugar, vamsalocana, honey, iksuraka, pippali and kapikacchi seeds added in 1/4 quantity. Made into boluses of udumbara fruit size.

formulations.name: Sastikadi Gutika (Fertility-Producing Bolus)

ingredients.herb_name: Kapikacchi seeds (decoction in black gram decoction)

formulations.preparation_method: Rice juice extracted with milk and cow-milk cooked with decoctions. Powders added to solidify. Honey, sugar added and boluses of jujube size prepared, fried in ghee.
indications: large progeny even in old age

formulations.name: Evacuation Formulation (Pre-Rasayana Cleansing)
formulations.preparation_method: Powders of all ingredients combined and taken with hot water. After evacuation and routine dietetic regimen, barley preparation with ghee given for 3, 5 or 7 days.

formulations.name: Musta-Parpataka Kashaya
formulations.preparation_method: Prepared as cold infusion or decoction

formulations.name: Sunthi-Parpataka-Duralabha Kashaya
formulations.preparation_method: Prepared as cold infusion or decoction

formulations.name: Kiratatikta-Musta-Guduchi-Sunthi-Patha-Ushira-Udichya Kashaya
formulations.preparation_method: Decoction

formulations.name: Indrayava-Patola-Katurohini Kashaya
formulations.preparation_method: Decoction - alleviates remittent fever (Santata jwara)

formulations.name: Patola-Sariva-Musta-Patha-Katurohini Kashaya
formulations.preparation_method: Decoction - alleviates double quotidian fever (Satata jwara)

formulations.name: Nimba-Patola-Triphala-Mrdwika-Musta-Kutaja Kashaya
formulations.preparation_method: Decoction - alleviates quotidian fever (Anyedushka jwara)

formulations.name: Kiratatikta-Guduchi-Chandana-Sunthi Kashaya
formulations.preparation_method: Decoction - alleviates tertian fever (Tryitiyaka jwara)

formulations.name: Guduchi-Amalaka-Musta Kashaya
formulations.preparation_method: Decoction - alleviates quartan fever (Chaturthaka jwara)

formulations.name: Brhati-Kantakari-Kutaja-Musta-Devadaru-Sunthi-Cavya Kashaya
formulations.preparation_method: Decoction
indications: Sannipataja jwara (fever caused by all three dosas)

formulations.name: Pippali-Chandana-Musta-Ushira-Katurohini-Indrayava-Bhimyamalaki-Sariva-Ativisha-Shalaparni-Draksha-Amalaka-Bilwa-Trayamana-Kantakari Ghrita
formulations.preparation_method: Ghee cooked with these drugs

formulations.name: Vasa-Guduchi-Triphala-Trayamana-Yavasaka Ghrita
formulations.preparation_method: Ghee cooked with decoction of Vasa, Guduchi, Triphala, Trayamana, Yavasaka along with double milk and paste of Pippali, Musta, Chandana, Mrdwika, Utpala and Sunthi

formulations.name: Candanadya Taila
formulations.preparation_method: All shitavirya (cold potency) drugs boiled into decoction. Oil half the quantity of decoction cooked with decoction, double milk and paste of same drugs
indications: Fever with burning sensation requiring massage

formulations.name: Kiratatikta-Kutaki-Musta-Parpataka-Guduchi Kashaya (Anti-relapse)
formulations.preparation_method: Decoction taken regularly

formulations.name: Vasa Ghrita

ingredients.form: whole plant including branches, leaves and root

formulations.preparation_method: Vasa along with branches, leaves and root boiled and made into decoction. Ghee cooked with this decoction putting Vasa flowers as paste. Taken with honey

formulations.name: Shatavari-Dadima-Tintidika-Kakoli-Meda-Madhuka-Vidari Ghrita (Shatavaryadi Ghrita)
formulations.preparation_method: Ghee cooked with paste of root of Bijapura and four times milk

formulations.name: Tryashanadi Ghrita (for Vatajgulma)
formulations.preparation_method: Ghee cooked with paste of above drugs along with milk

formulations.name: Hingu-Sauvarcaladi Ghrita
formulations.preparation_method: Ghee cooked with paste of these drugs along with curd

formulations.name: Hapusadi Ghrita
formulations.preparation_method: Ghee cooked with paste of above drugs along with juice of kola and radish, milk, curd and pomegranate
indications: Pain in pelvis, cardiac region and sides

formulations.name: Pippalyadya Ghrita
formulations.preparation_method: All cooked together with milk four times the quantity

formulations.name: Hingwadi Churna and Gutika
formulations.preparation_method: All powdered together for churna. For gutika: impregnated with juice of Matulunga for a week and made into pills of jujube size
indications: Pain in sides, heart or pelvic region
Pain in anus or vaginal tract
formulations.dosage: Used in food and drinks before or after meals

formulations.name: Lashuna Kshira (Garlic Milk)
formulations.preparation_method: Dehusked garlic boiled in milk along with eight times water. When only the milk remains it is taken by the patient

formulations.name: Rohinyadya Ghrita
formulations.preparation_method: All boiled in eight times water remaining equal to ghee (160 gm). Ghee cooked with this decoction

formulations.name: Trayamanadya Ghrita
formulations.preparation_method: Trayamana boiled in ten times water remaining to one-fifth. Filtered and added with pastes. Cooked with juice of amalaka, milk and ghee
indications: Visarpa (erysipelas) caused by pitta and rakta

formulations.name: Drakshadya Ghrita
formulations.preparation_method: Boiled in water 2.56 litres remaining to one-fourth. Added with ghee, sugarcane juice and milk along with haritaki paste and cooked. Sugar and honey added at end

formulations.name: Dashamula Ghrita (for Kaphajgulma)
formulations.preparation_method: Ghee cooked with the ten roots along with above drugs

formulations.name: Bhallatakadya Ghrita
formulations.preparation_method: Bhallataka and panchamula pounded and boiled in water 2.56 litres remaining to one-fourth. Ghee cooked with this decoction along with milk and paste of other drugs

formulations.name: Nilinyadya Ghrita
formulations.preparation_method: Herbs boiled in water 2.56 litres reduced to one-fourth. Ghee cooked with decoction mixing curd and Sunthi latex. Taken in dose of 40 gm with gruel-scum

formulations.name: Madhvasava (for Prameha)
formulations.preparation_method: Boiled in water 10.24 litres remaining to one-fourth; fermented as asava

formulations.name: Dantyasava
formulations.preparation_method: Prepared as asava

formulations.name: Madhvasava (for Kustha)
formulations.preparation_method: Khadira and devadaru boiled to serve as water base; all ingredients combined in iron vessel for one month

formulations.name: Kanakabindu Arista
formulations.preparation_method: Decoction of khadira kept in ghee-smeared vessel; powders added; kept for one month within paddy grains

formulations.name: Mustadi Curna
formulations.preparation_method: Powdered together; combined with nine parts saturating preparation; added with honey and ghee

formulations.name: Mahatikta Ghrta
formulations.preparation_method: Drugs powdered into paste; paste one-fourth, water eight times, amalaki juice two times the ghee; ghee cooked with these

formulations.name: Mahakhadira Ghrta

ingredients.herb_name: Karanja, nimba, vetasa, parpata, kutaja, vasa, vidanga, haridra, daruharidra, aragvadha, guduchi, triphala, trivrt, saptaparna (combined)

formulations.preparation_method: Drugs boiled in 102.4 litres water remaining to one-eighth; amalaki juice added equal to decoction; ghee cooked adding mahatiktaka paste

formulations.name: Tiktasatpalaka Ghrta
formulations.preparation_method: First group boiled in 2.56 kg water remaining to one-eighth; filtered; second group made into paste; ghee 240 gm cooked with decoction and paste

formulations.name: Svetakaraviradi Taila
formulations.preparation_method: Oil prepared with these ingredients

formulations.name: Svetakaravira-pallavadya Taila

ingredients.herb_name: White karavira (tender leaves, root and bark)

formulations.preparation_method: Oil prepared with paste of drugs in 1 part quantity and four times cow's urine

formulations.name: Tikteksvakvadi Taila
formulations.preparation_method: Mustard oil cooked with paste of these drugs along with four times cow's urine

formulations.name: Kanakaksiri Taila

ingredients.herb_name: Root and young leaves of karavira (decoction)

formulations.preparation_method: Mustard or tila oil prepared with paste of drugs with decoction of karavira and four times cow's urine; stored in bitter bottlegourd vessel

formulations.name: Siddharthaka Bath
formulations.preparation_method: Decoction prepared for external use as bath

formulations.name: Duralabhadya Ghrta
formulations.preparation_method: First group boiled in ten times water remaining to one-tenth; decoction filtered; paste of second group added; ghee 640 gm cooked with double milk
indications: Pain in shoulders, sides and head

formulations.name: Jivantyadi Ghrta
formulations.preparation_method: All in equal quantity powdered; ghee prepared with these

formulations.name: Yavanisadava Curna
formulations.preparation_method: All powdered together
indications: Pain in heart, spleen and sides

formulations.name: Taligadya Curna and Gutika
formulations.preparation_method: All powdered together; sugarcandy may be cooked to make tablets

formulations.name: Kalyanaka Ghrta
formulations.preparation_method: Twenty drugs total (10 gm each) cooked well with ghee 640 gm and four times water

formulations.name: Mahakalyanaka Ghrta

ingredients.herb_name: Two types of masa (masa and rajamasa)

formulations.preparation_method: 21 drugs boiled in water; ghee cooked with decoction and four times milk of primipara cow; paste drugs added

formulations.name: Mahapaisacika Ghrta
formulations.preparation_method: Ghee cooked with these drugs

formulations.name: Lasunadya Ghrta (1st)
formulations.preparation_method: All cooked together; when cooled powdered asafoetida and honey added
indications: All types of insanity (innate and exogenous)

formulations.name: Lasunadya Ghrta (2nd)
formulations.preparation_method: Garlic and dasamula boiled in water remaining to one-fourth; ghee cooked with garlic juice and all juices and paste drugs

formulations.name: Pancagavya Ghrta
formulations.preparation_method: Ghee cooked with equal quantity of cow's dung juice, sour curd, milk and urine

formulations.name: Mahapancagavya Ghrta
formulations.preparation_method: First group boiled in water 10.24 litres remaining to one-fourth; paste group added; ghee 640 gm cooked with equal quantity each of cowdung juice, sour curd, milk and urine

formulations.name: Eladi Gutika
formulations.preparation_method: All ingredients powdered together and mixed with honey to make boluses of 10 gm each.

formulations.name: Amritaprasa Ghrita
formulations.preparation_method: All ingredients cooked together. When self-cooled, honey, sugar and aromatic powders added.
formulations.dosage: Proper dose; taken on milk or meat-soup diet

formulations.name: Swadamstradi Ghrita
formulations.preparation_method: Herbs boiled with water to make decoction. Ghee cooked with four times milk and paste of herbs.
indications: Promotes strength and musculature in those exhausted by physical exertion, women, wine, load-carrying and travelling

formulations.name: Sarpirgu da 1 (First Bolus formulation)
formulations.preparation_method: Decoction prepared. Ghee cooked with milk, pastes and decoction. When self-cooled, sugar and powders added. Made into boluses of 40 gm wrapped with bhurja patra.
indications: Exhaustion by physical exertion, women or load-carrying
formulations.anupana: Milk; wine in case of kapha

formulations.name: Sarpirgu da 2 (Second Bolus formulation)
formulations.preparation_method: Herbs powdered with milk, juices and ghee cooked together. When self-cooled sugar and honey added and formed into boluses.

formulations.name: Sarpirgu da 3 (Third Bolus formulation)
formulations.preparation_method: Herbs powdered. Milk, oil, ghee and sugar boiled then powder added. Made into boluses of 40 gm each.
indications: Attains corpulence by increase of rasa

formulations.name: Sarpirmodaka 5 (Fifth Modaka formulation)
formulations.preparation_method: Liquids cooked together. Solids pounded with sugarcane juice and paste added during cooking. When self-cooled, honey added and boluses prepared mixing with marica and jiraka powder.
indications: Desire for corpulence, lustre and strength

formulations.name: Saindhavadi Curna
formulations.preparation_method: All powdered together.

formulations.name: Sadava
formulations.preparation_method: All powdered together and mixed with sugar.

formulations.name: Gandiradyarista
formulations.preparation_method: All drugs cooked in whey in cowdung fire till one-third remains, filtered and cooled. Cooked again in curd water. Sugarcandy added. Kept in earthen jar pasted with citraka and pippali for ten days in open space.

formulations.name: Astasata Arista
formulations.preparation_method: All powdered together, kept in jar smeared with honey, with water. Summer: one week; Winter: two weeks.

formulations.name: Punarnarvadyarista
formulations.preparation_method: Decoction filtered and cooled. Old jaggery and honey added. Stored in jar smeared with ghee and honey within heap of barley for a month. Aromatic powders added. Kept again in vessel smeared with honey and ghee till matured.
indications: Promotes complexion, strength, life span, immunity and energy

formulations.name: Triphaladyarista
formulations.preparation_method: All together kept in vessel of ghee within the heap of barley grains for a month.

formulations.name: Ksaragudika
formulations.preparation_method: All dissolved in water and cooked till solid and uncharred. Pills of 5 gm made and dried.

formulations.name: Kamsaharitaki
formulations.preparation_method: Haritaki and jaggery mixed in dasamula decoction and cooked to linctus. Trikatu and trisugandhi powders added. When well-cooled, honey and yavaksara added.
indications: Disorders of urine, vata and semen
formulations.dosage: One haritaki fruit followed by linctus 20 gm

formulations.name: Citrakaghrta
formulations.preparation_method: Milk kept in jar plastered with citraka paste until curdled. Churned with same paste. Ghee extracted and cooked with buttermilk with citraka root paste added.
formulations.dosage: Taken with food or gruel with buttermilk containing ghee

formulations.name: Patoladya Curna
formulations.preparation_method: Made into decoction. Powdered form taken in dose of 40 gm with cow's urine.
formulations.anupana: Cow's urine; after purgation - soft food with wild animal meat soup

formulations.name: Narayana Curna
formulations.preparation_method: All together powdered.
formulations.anupana: Variable by disease: buttermilk, badara juice, urine, prasanna, curd-scum, pomegranate juice, vrksamla, hot water

formulations.name: Hapusadya Curna
formulations.preparation_method: All powdered together.
formulations.anupana: Pomegranate juice, triphala decoction, meat soup, cow's urine, or tepid water

formulations.name: Nilinyadi Curna
formulations.preparation_method: All powdered and mixed together.

formulations.name: Snuhiksira Ghrita
formulations.preparation_method: Milk with snuhi latex curdled and ghee extracted by churning. Cooked with trivrt. Alternate: ghee cooked with eight times milk, snuhi latex paste 40 gm and trivrt 240 gm.
formulations.anupana: Liquid gruel, sweet milk or meat soup after taking ghee

formulations.name: Takrarista
formulations.preparation_method: All powdered together, mixed with buttermilk to make mildly sour and pungent, kept in a ghee vessel till sourness and pungency manifested
formulations.anupana: Before, mid and after meals in condition of thirst

formulations.name: Abhayarista
formulations.preparation_method: Boiled in water 40.96 litres remaining to one-fourth. Filtered, cooled, added with jaggery 8 kg and kept in a ghee vessel for a fortnight

formulations.name: Dantyarista
formulations.preparation_method: Crushed and boiled in water 10.24 litres, triphala pulp added. When one-fourth remains filtered, cooled, jaggery added, kept in ghee vessel for a fortnight

formulations.name: Phalarista
formulations.preparation_method: Crushed and boiled in water 20.48 litres remaining to one-fourth. After filtering, jaggery added and kept in ghee vessel for a fortnight. Formulated by Krsnatreya
indications: Retention of faeces, urine and flatus

formulations.name: Sarkara Arista
formulations.preparation_method: Boiled in water 10.24 litres till reduced to one-fourth. Filtered, cooled, sugar added. Kept in jar smeared with ghee and pasted inside with pippali, cavya, priyarigu, honey and ghee for a fortnight
indications: Retention of stool, urine, flatus and eructation

formulations.name: Kanakarista
formulations.preparation_method: Amalaki boiled in water 20.48 litres to one-fourth. Filtered, cooled. Cold decoction of dried grapes mixed. Sugar, honey, spice powders added. Kept in ghee vessel slightly fumigated with srkara and aguru for a fortnight

formulations.name: Kutajadi Rasakriya
formulations.preparation_method: Kutaja bark boiled in rain water till entire extract comes out. Filtered, mocarasa, lajjalu and priyarigu added. Cooked again till liquid becomes viscous and sticks to ladle
indications: Severe raktapitta directed to both pathways

formulations.name: Hriberadi Ghrta
formulations.preparation_method: Ghee cooked with paste of above drugs with juice of cangeri

formulations.name: Dasamaladya Ghrta

ingredients.herb_name: Five salts (saindhava, audbhida, samudra, bida, romaka, sauvarcala, pakya)

formulations.preparation_method: Boiled with sour gruel, curd, sauviraka remaining to one-fourth. Ghee cooked with this decoction adding swarjika and yavaksara. Salt powder mixed with prepared ghee
indications: Promotes strength, complexion and digestion of food

formulations.name: Tryisanadya Ghrta
formulations.preparation_method: Ghee cooked with trikatu, triphala and jaggery
indications: Grahani roga with diminished fire (slow digestion)

formulations.name: Citrakadya Gutika
formulations.preparation_method: All powdered together and made into pills with juice of matulunga or pomegranate

formulations.name: Maricadya Curna
formulations.preparation_method: All powdered finely together

formulations.name: Candanadya Ghrta
formulations.preparation_method: All 80 gm drugs boiled in water 10.24 litres reduced to one-fourth. Ghee cooked with the paste of 10 gm drugs
indications: Tiktaka ghrta also recommended for paittika grahani

formulations.name: Nagaradya Curna
formulations.preparation_method: All powdered together in equal parts. Commended by Krsnatreya

formulations.name: Bhinimbadya Curna
formulations.preparation_method: All powdered together

formulations.name: Madhukasava
formulations.preparation_method: Boiled in water 30.72 litres reduced to one-fourth. Self-cooled, honey added, kept in earthen jar pasted inside with ela, mrnala and aguru for a month

formulations.name: Duralabhasava
formulations.preparation_method: Cooked in water 40.96 litres to one-fourth. Cooled, filtered, jaggery, honey and powders added. Kept in ghee vessel for a fortnight

formulations.name: Madhvarista
formulations.preparation_method: Honey with equal water kept in new earthen jar smeared inside with pippali and honey and incensed with aguru. Powders added and kept for a month

formulations.name: Navayasa Curna
formulations.type: Curna with Bhasma (Powder with metallic preparation)
formulations.preparation_method: All herbal powders in equal parts mixed with nine parts of lauha bhasma. Formulated by Krsnatreya

formulations.name: Manduravataka
formulations.preparation_method: All powders cooked separately in eight times cow's urine. Pure mandura in double quantity added and boluses of 10 gm (udumbara fruit size) made

formulations.name: Yogaraja
formulations.preparation_method: All powdered finely, mixed with ample honey and stored in a clean iron vessel

formulations.name: Silajatuvataka

ingredients.herb_name: Decoction of indrayava, triphala, nimba, patola, musta, sunthi

formulations.preparation_method: Silajatu impregnated with decoction for 10, 20 or 30 days. All powdered together, mixed with honey 120 gm and made into boluses of 10 gm each
indications: Disorders of semen, urine and digestion
formulations.anupana: Pomegranate juice / milk / bird meat soup / water / sura or asava

formulations.name: Punarnavamandura
formulations.preparation_method: All herbal powders together cooked with cow's urine 5.12 kg and finally made into pills 5 gm each

formulations.name: Dhatryavaleha
formulations.preparation_method: All powdered together, cooked with amalaki juice 10.24 litres into linctus. Self-cooled, honey added

formulations.name: Dadimadya Ghrta
formulations.preparation_method: Ghee cooked with the paste of drugs and water

formulations.name: Katukadya Ghrta
formulations.preparation_method: Ghee cooked with paste of drugs with four times milk

formulations.name: Dhatryarista
formulations.preparation_method: Juice of 200 amalaki fruits with honey in one-eighth quantity, pippali and sugar kept in smeared jar for a fortnight

formulations.name: Kantakari Ghrta (for Vatika Kasa)
formulations.preparation_method: Ghee 640 gm cooked with 1.2 litres decoction of each kanyakari and gudaci

formulations.name: Pippalyadya Ghrta
formulations.preparation_method: Ghee 640 gm cooked in decoction of dasamila 2.56 litres with the paste of the above ingredients each 5 gm

formulations.name: Tryusanadya Ghrta

ingredients.quantity: four times the quantity of ghee

formulations.preparation_method: Ghee 640 gm cooked in four times milk with the paste of all ingredients each 10 gm
indications: pain in head, heart and sides

formulations.name: Rasna Ghrta
formulations.preparation_method: Rasna, dasamila, satavari, kulattha, badara and barley grains and goat's flesh boiled in water 10.24 litres reduced to one-fourth. With this extract ghee 2.56 kg cooked with equal quantity of milk and paste of ten jivaniya drugs each 40 gm
indications: pain in groins and vaginal track

formulations.name: Citrakadi Leha
formulations.preparation_method: Paste of all herbs put in decoction of kantakari 2 litres; sugar candy 800 gm and ghee 160 gm added and cooked. When prepared and cooled, honey, pippali and powdered vamsalocana each 160 gm added

formulations.name: Agastya Haritaki (Rasayana)
formulations.preparation_method: All herbs and barley boiled in water 12.8 litres till barley grains are cooked. Filtered. Haritaki fruits and jaggery 4 kg put in and cooked. At end, ghee, tila oil and pippali powder each 160 gm added. When cooled, honey 160 gm added

formulations.name: Satyadya Curna
formulations.preparation_method: All in equal parts and sugar eight parts, powdered together

formulations.name: Muktadya Curna
formulations.preparation_method: All powdered together in equal parts
indications: eye diseases (defects of vision, cataract, corneal opacity, darkness, pilla, itching, congestion, pterygium) as collyrium

formulations.name: Tejovatyadi Ghrta
formulations.preparation_method: All ingredients each 10 gm, hingu 2.5 gm with ghee 640 gm cooked in four times water

formulations.name: Manasiladi Ghrta
formulations.preparation_method: Ghee 640 gm cooked with realgar, sarjarasa, lac, haridra, padmaka, manjistha and ela each 10 gm

formulations.name: Dasamuladi Ghrta (for Kaphaja Kasa)
formulations.preparation_method: Ghee 640 gm cooked in decoction of dasamula 2.56 litres with the paste of the above herbs
indications: disorders caused by kapha and vata

formulations.name: Kantakasri Ghrta
formulations.preparation_method: Ghee 640 gm cooked in 2.56 litres of decoction of kantakari (with root, fruit and leaves) with paste of all the above herbs

formulations.name: Kulatthadi Ghrta
formulations.preparation_method: Ghrta cooked in decoction of horse gram with pancakola

formulations.name: Chest Wound Cough Formulation (Urakshataja Kasa preparation)
formulations.preparation_method: All ingredients together cooked on mild fire. When cooled, ghee and honey added

formulations.name: Dasamuladi Ghrta (for Kshayaja Kasa)
formulations.preparation_method: Ghee cooked in decoction of two pancamulas (dasamula), triphala, cavika, bhargi, citraka, kulattha, pippalimula, patha, kola and yava with paste of sunthi, duralabha, pippali, sali, puskaramula and karkatasrigi in equal parts. When prepared, powder of two alkalis (yavaksara and svarjiksara) added

formulations.name: Dvipancamuladi Ghrta
formulations.preparation_method: Ghee cooked in decoction of two pancamulas; two alkali salts added at end in proper dose

formulations.name: Gudacyadi Ghrta
formulations.preparation_method: All herbs decocted in four times water reduced to one-fourth. Ghee taken in quantity equal to that of the decoction and cooked

formulations.name: Kasamardadi Ghrta (for Kshayaja Kasa)
formulations.preparation_method: Ghee 640 gm cooked in milk and grape juice 2.56 kg with the paste of all herbs each 10 gm

formulations.name: Padmakadi Leha
formulations.preparation_method: All herbs in equal parts powdered together and administered with honey and ghee

formulations.name: Haritaki Linctus (for Dyspnoea and Cough)
formulations.preparation_method: 20 fruits of haritaki boiled in barley decoction 5.12 kg. When cooked well, kneaded and added with old jaggery 240 gm, realgar 10 gm, rasanjana 5 gm and pippali 5 gm

formulations.name: Padmaka Linctus (for all Cough types)
formulations.preparation_method: All in equal parts finely powdered. Honey, ghee and sugar each in quantity equal to total powder mixed with it by churning

formulations.name: Cangeri Ghrta (for Prolapse of Rectum)
formulations.preparation_method: Ghee cooked with cangeri, kola, sour curd, dry ginger and alkali

formulations.name: Gavyadi Ghrta (for Prolapse of Rectum)
formulations.preparation_method: Soured ghee cooked with cavya, pippalimula, trikatu, bida, pomegranates, dhanyaka, jiraka and citraka

formulations.name: Piccha Basti (Slimy Enema for Pittaja Atisara)

ingredients.form: roasted and pounded, pressed in milk

formulations.preparation_method: Fresh flower-stalks of salmali wrapped in fresh kusa grass, plastered with black earth, heated on cow-dung fire until dry. Stalks taken out, pounded, bolus 40 gm pressed in boiled milk and filtered. Mixed with tila oil 640 gm and ghee 640 gm, added with madhuka paste in adequate quantity
formulations.anupana: milk or meat-soup of wild animals after

formulations.name: Satavari Ghrta (for Raktatisara)
formulations.preparation_method: Ghee cooked with satavari in milk

formulations.name: Kutaja Ghrta (Sixfold Drug Ghrta for Tridoshaja Atisara)
formulations.preparation_method: Ghee cooked with the six drugs along with the scum of liquid gruel
indications: severe diarrhoea caused by three doshas

formulations.name: Piccha Basti (Slimy Enema for Kaphaja Atisara)
formulations.preparation_method: Paste of pippali, bilva, kustha, satahva and vaca added with salt made into enema. Evening: unctuous enema with warm bilva taila or tila oil cooked with paste of above drugs
indications: kaphaja atisara with obstruction due to vata and kapha

formulations.name: Nyagrodha-Ghee Preparation (for Haemorrhage)

ingredients.form: crushed and kept in hot water day and night
crushed and kept in hot water day and night
crushed and kept in hot water day and night

formulations.preparation_method: Leaf buds of nyagrodha, udumbara and asvathha crushed and kept in hot water for day and night. Ghee cooked with this extract and mixed with half sugar and quarter honey

formulations.name: Trayamana Ghrta
formulations.preparation_method: Ghee cooked with Trayamana decoction. Also milk boiled with Trayamana used as purgative.

formulations.name: Patoladi Decoction (visarpa variant)
formulations.preparation_method: Decoction of patola, nimba, daruharida, katurohini, madhuyasti and trayamana; triphala and grains of lentils added with ghee

formulations.name: Kiratatikta-Lodhra compound decoction
formulations.preparation_method: All ingredients made into decoction

formulations.name: Draksa-Parpataka overnight decoction (thirst / visarpa)
formulations.preparation_method: All herbs kept overnight in water, given as drink

formulations.name: Ghrta cooked with Darva juice
formulations.preparation_method: Ghee cooked with juice of darva

formulations.name: Kampillaka-Vidanga-Daruharidra-Karafija Taila
formulations.preparation_method: All pounded together and cooked into oil

formulations.name: Mrtasamjivana Agada
formulations.preparation_method: Collected in pusya constellation. Pounded together in equal quantity. Made into pills. Recitation of specific hymn during pounding.
indications: Revival of apparently dead by poisoning
formulations.special_notes: Revealed by Brahma before appearance of nectar. Promotes auspiciousness, corpulence and life-span.

formulations.name: Gandhahasti Agada
formulations.preparation_method: All in equal parts pounded with goat urine. Impregnated alternately with cow's and horse's bile for one week.
indications: Counteracts poison quickly when applied on incised scalp
Insanity, epilepsy, cataract, patala, nilika, head-diseases, suskaksipaka, pilla, arbuda, arma, itching (as collyrium)
Poison from poisoned arrow, licking, biting, ingestion (as paste)
Piles and hardness of bowels (on anus)
Scrotal enlargement, kitibha, kustha, leucoderma, eczema

formulations.name: Mahagandhahasti Agada
formulations.preparation_method: In pusya constellation, pounded with cow bile, made into pills.
indications: All poisons (rats, spiders, serpents, root poisons)
Eye diseases (pilla, itching, timira, night-blindness, cataract, arbuda)
formulations.special_notes: 60-drug formula revealed by Tryambaka (Rudra) to Kubera. Constant use with wholesome and measured diet gives best results.

formulations.name: Ksaragada (Alkali anti-poison pill)
formulations.preparation_method: Alkali from young palasa tree cooked with all powders in equal quantity till it sticks to laddle. Made into pills, dried in shade.

formulations.name: Pancasirisa Agada
formulations.preparation_method: Five parts of Sirisa taken together in equal quantity
indications: Best anti-poison for destroying all types of poison

formulations.name: Amrtaghrta
formulations.preparation_method: Each herb 10 gm used as paste for cooking ghee 2.56 litres with equal quantity of water and goat's and cow's urine 7.68 litres
indications: Revival of near-dead from poisoning and hanging
Seizures of evil spirits and grahas

formulations.name: Vartaku-Phanita-Soot resuscitative formulation
formulations.preparation_method: Combined together
indications: Resuscitative in near-dead patients from poisoning (8th impulse)

formulations.name: Sankavisa (suspicion poisoning) Potion
formulations.preparation_method: Combined and given as potion
indications: Sankavisa — psychosomatic poisoning-like symptoms arising from fear/suspicion of bite in darkness
formulations.special_notes: Patient should also be consoled, sponged with incantation-purified water, and given exhilarating measures.

formulations.name: Animal anti-poison powder (universal for quadrupeds)
formulations.preparation_method: Powder of all drugs along with rock salt and ananta, mixed with cow bile and honey
indications: Universal anti-poison for animals (quadrupeds bitten by poisonous animals)

formulations.name: Ashtanga Lavana
formulations.preparation_method: All drugs are powdered and mixed together
formulations.anupana: Sweet and sour juices; used as adjuvant to preparations of wheat and barley and meat

formulations.name: Anu Taila
formulations.preparation_method: Sesamum seeds impregnated with goat's milk, pounded with same milk. Paste heated on mild fire, mixed with madhuka powder, pressed to extract oil. Oil cooked with decoction of dashamula with paste of rasna and madhuka. Saindhava salt added at end. Process repeated ten times.

formulations.name: Mayura Ghrita

ingredients.herb_name: Peacock (without feathers, bile, intestines, faeces, beak, feet)
ingredients.form: decocted in water with dashamula and other drugs

formulations.preparation_method: Peacock decocted with dashamula, bala, rasna, triphala and madhuka. Ghee 640 gm cooked with equal milk and paste of vitaliser drugs 10 gm each.
indications: Diseases of ear, eye, nose, tongue, palate, mouth, throat

formulations.name: Mahamayura Ghrita

ingredients.herb_name: Same decoction base as Mayura Ghrita

formulations.preparation_method: With the same decoction base as Mayura Ghrita, ghee 640 gm cooked with four times milk and paste of 10 gm each of the listed drugs. Used as snuff, intake, massage and enema.

formulations.name: Khadiradi Gutika
formulations.preparation_method: Khadira 4 kg and arimeda 8 kg washed and disintegrated, cooked in water 40.96 litres until reduced to 10.24 litres. Strained and again heated slowly until thickened. Then powders of listed drugs 10 gm each added. Brought down and cooled. Lavanga, nakha, kakkola, jatikosa 40 gm each and camphor 160 gm added. Pills made and dried.
indications: Looseness, displacement, caries and organisms of teeth
All diseases of teeth, mouth and throat

formulations.name: Khadiradi Taila

ingredients.herb_name: Same decoction and paste as Khadiradi Gutika

formulations.preparation_method: Oil prepared with the decoction and paste of all the drugs used in Khadiradi Gutika.
indications: All diseases of teeth, mouth and throat

formulations.name: Kalaka Churna
formulations.preparation_method: All drugs powdered and mixed. Powder mixed with honey.
indications: Diseases of teeth, mouth and throat

formulations.name: Pitaka Churna
formulations.preparation_method: All drugs powdered and mixed. Mixed with honey and suspended in ghee-scum.
formulations.anupana: Mixed with honey, suspended in ghee-scum

formulations.name: Mahanila Taila
formulations.preparation_method: All drugs pounded. Oil of bibhitaka with four times amalaka juice cooked on fire or heated in sun with paste until liquid is dried up. Filtered and stored in iron vessel.
formulations.dosage: Used as intake, snuff and head-massage

formulations.name: Sukhavati Varti
formulations.preparation_method: All drugs pounded together and made into stick.
formulations.dosage: Applied to eye as paste (after rubbing stick)

formulations.name: Drishtiprada Varti
formulations.preparation_method: All drugs pounded with goat's milk and impregnated with the same in a copper vessel for a week. Again pounded with goat's milk and made into stick.

formulations.name: Astakatvara Taila
formulations.preparation_method: Oil 640 gm cooked with rock salt, sunthi, pippalimula, citraka, bhallataka nuts and sour gruel 5.12 litres

formulations.name: Mustard oil with Kustha and Devadaru (for Urustambha)
formulations.preparation_method: Mustard oil cooked with the mentioned drugs and added with honey in proper dose

formulations.name: Oil with Piluparni group (for Urustambha)
formulations.preparation_method: Oil cooked with piluparni, payasya, rasni, goksura, vaca, sarala, aguru and patha; taken with honey
formulations.dosage: 86 gm or 160 gm added with honey

formulations.name: Balataila (Vatavyadhi)
formulations.preparation_method: Oil 2.56 kg cooked with juice of sahacara 4 kg, paste of its root 400 gm and four times milk. When prepared, powder of sharkara 720 gm dissolved in it.

formulations.name: Goksura (Swadamstra) Taila
formulations.preparation_method: Oil 640 gm cooked with juice of goksura 1.28 litres, equal quantity of milk, sunthi and jaggery
formulations.dosage: When digested, gruel with milk should be taken as diet

formulations.name: Balataila (Krsnatreya - major formulation)
formulations.preparation_method: Oil 2.56 kg cooked with decoction of bala 4 kg, guduchi 1 kg, rasna 500 gm in water 2.56 litres reduced to one-tenth, with curd-water, sugarcane juice and sukta each equal to oil, goat's milk in half quantity and paste of the listed drugs each 40 gm. After preparation, filtered and added with paste of aromatic leaves.

formulations.name: Amrta Taila
formulations.preparation_method: Guduchi 20 kg boiled in water 81.92 litres reduced to one-fourth. With this decoction, oil 5.12 kg cooked with equal quantity of milk and paste of all listed drugs.

formulations.name: Rasna Taila
formulations.preparation_method: Oil 10.24 kg cooked in decoction of rasna 40 kg with paste of aromatic drugs from Himalayas and Eladi group drugs

formulations.name: Malakadya Taila
formulations.preparation_method: Equal quantities of milk, oil, sour curd and sour gruel cooked together with paste of listed drugs

formulations.name: Vyashamuladi Taila
formulations.preparation_method: Oil 2.56 kg cooked with decoction of vasa root and guduchi 8 kg (4 kg each), citraka and ashwagandha 4 kg (2 kg each) along with milk. More effective when Eladi group drugs added.
indications: Patients broken and shattered by disorders of Vata

formulations.name: Malaka Taila (Mulaka Taila)
formulations.preparation_method: All decoction drugs 400 gm each made into decoction. With this, oil 540 gm cooked with paste of sarvagandha group each 10 gm along with curd, sour gruel, sour liquid of horse gram, radish juice and sugarcane juice each 640 ml.

formulations.name: Nirgundi Taila
formulations.preparation_method: Oil cooked with equal quantity of juice taken from root and leaves of nirgundi

formulations.name: Mahasneha (Great Fat formulation)
formulations.preparation_method: Listed drugs boiled in water 10.24 litres reduced to one-fourth. Then urine, sour gruel, sour curd, dadima, yakshamla, oil, fat, ghee, marrow, milk and paste of vitaliser drugs 240 gm added and cooked.

formulations.name: Dashamula Ghrita (Vatavyadhi)
formulations.preparation_method: Dashamula 160 gm and yava, kola, kulattha 640 gm each boiled in water 10.24 litres reduced to one-fourth. With this decoction and paste of vitaliser drugs along with sharkara, kharjara, kasmarya, draksha, badara, phalgu and milk, ghee 640 gm cooked.
indications: Used as intake, massage and enema
formulations.dosage: Used as intake, massage and enema

formulations.name: Parusaka Ghrita
formulations.preparation_method: Ghee cooked with paste of trayamana, tamalaki, kakoli, ksirakakoli, shatavari and kaseruka and decoction of same drugs adding thereto juices of parusaka, draksha, kasmarya, sugarcane and vidari in equal quantity and milk four times.

formulations.name: Jivaniya Ghrita
formulations.preparation_method: Drugs 80 gm each boiled in water 10.24 litres reduced to one-fourth. Milk, amalaka juice, sugarcane juice, goat's flesh soup added with ghee 2.56 kg and cooked on mild fire with paste of secondary drugs. When prepared, honey added and stored in clean container with prescribed ritual.

formulations.name: Madhuparnyadi Taila
formulations.preparation_method: Madhuka 4 kg decocted in water reduced to one-fourth. With this, oil 2.56 kg cooked with equal quantity of milk and paste of listed drugs each 40 gm.
formulations.dosage: Used in four ways: intake, massage, snuff and enema

formulations.name: Sukumaraka Taila
formulations.preparation_method: First drugs boiled in water 40.96 litres reduced to one-eighth. Filtered. With this, oil 2.56 kg cooked with equal quantity juices of amalaka, kasmarya, vidari, sugarcane and milk 40.96 litres and paste of drugs 40 gm each. When prepared honey 640 gm added.
formulations.dosage: Used as snuff, massage, intake and enema

formulations.name: Amrtadya Taila (Amrta Taila for Vatarakta)
formulations.preparation_method: All drugs except paste drugs boiled in water 1024 litres reduced to 40.96 litres. With this, oil 10.24 litres cooked with five times milk and paste of candana, usira, nagakesara, patra, ela, aguru, kustha, tagara, madhuyasti each 120 gm and manjistha 320 gm.
formulations.dosage: Used in all ways (intake, massage, snuff, enema)

formulations.name: Mahapadmaka Taila
formulations.preparation_method: Padmaka and other drugs each 200 gm decocted in water. With this, oil cooked with equal quantity of sauvira and paste of drugs 20 gm each and manjistha 40 gm.

formulations.name: Khuddaka Padmaka Taila
formulations.preparation_method: Oil prepared with decoction of padmaka, usira, madhuyasti and haridra along with paste of sarja, manjistha, vita, kakoli and candana.

formulations.name: Madhuka Taila (cooked hundred times)
formulations.preparation_method: Madhuyasti 4 kg boiled with ten times milk reduced to one-fourth. With this, oil 40.96 kg cooked with paste or juice of madhuka repeatedly. Process repeated 100 times so that 100 pala (4 kg) of madhuka is processed.

formulations.name: Bala Taila (cooked hundred or thousand times)
formulations.preparation_method: Oil cooked with decoction and paste of bala with equal quantity of milk, repeated hundred or thousand times
indications: Alleviator of defects of semen and ovum

formulations.name: Pinda Taila
formulations.preparation_method: Oil prepared with beewax, manjistha, sarjarasa and sariva

formulations.name: Triphala-Trikatu Paste (Vatarakta)
formulations.preparation_method: All in equal quantity pounded. Paste applied on iron utensil in early morning and eaten in noon.
indications: Pain of vatarakta even caused by all three doshas
